title: Homogeneous quotient action and coefficient projections
statement: Let j:Z→X be a closed immersion, L invertible, J=j.ker with J²=0, and n≥0 [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-sc-invertible-module, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf, def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. Fix a TensorGradedPresentation T [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-presentation] and the canonical comparison data D=(a_r,k_r) [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Set F=j^*(J⊗L^n), N=(j^*L)^n, H=H¹(Z,-) [def-pc-module-pullback, def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. Fix e≥0, f:O_Z→N and x:O_Z→N^(e+1). Define s=c(f^⊗1), t=c(x), and Q_r=k_r^(-1)∘H¹(X,π_(n(r+1)),1), using the explicit homogeneous sections and degree projections [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-product-projection]. Suppose σ is a local quotient action on K satisfying i(σ(p(b))y)=b i(y) and commuting with restrictions, μ is its global endomorphism action, and ρ(g)=H¹(X,μ(g)). Then for every z∈H¹(X,K), Q_(e+1)(ρ(s)z)=H(mulTensorPowSection f F e 1)(Q_e(z)) and Q_(e+1)(ρ(t)z)=H(ρ_F^(-1);id_F⊗x)(H(ρ_F)(Q_0(z))). This statement asserts only action compatibility, with no section boundary, resolution, or derivation identity.
